verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents multiple passwordless-capable factors — hardware keys, biometric, certificates, and 'JumpCloud Go' as a phishing-resistant passwordless login method for SSO — indicating passwordless flows are supported. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm passkey (FIDO2/WebAuthn) support by name, nor detail the end-user enrollment/sign-in experience, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the passwordless flow working smoothly. missing for 10: explicit passkey/WebAuthn terminology, step-by-step employee sign-in UX documentation, independent verification of passwordless-only login success.
